scope: source-scene validation only; no heldout evaluation

social_comparison.rule: >=1.5% ADE or >=2.5% FDE improvement; >= 10/15 wins must hold for the same qualifying metric

gate_comparison.rule: >=0.75% ADE or >=1.25% FDE improvement; >= 9/15 wins must hold for the same qualifying metric

neighbor_statistics.selection: nearest at last observation; present at all eight observed frames; same recording; no future access
neighbor_statistics.split: unchanged stage-one manifest; target pedestrian split
neighbor_statistics.neighbor_split_policy: Candidates may be any observed pedestrian in the same source recording, including tracks assigned to the other target split; only their eight current observation coordinates are used, never their future labels.
